strategy: Frozen Track B signal logic + structural SR filter A/B v1
sr_engine: SR Reclaim v1 zone engine; 4H+1D body-edge pivot clusters; only confirmed/known zones at trade entry

variants.name: backing_zone
variants.rule: at least one active HTF SR zone overlaps the initial Entry-SL risk corridor

variants.name: clear_to_tp1
variants.rule: no active HTF SR zone blocks price between Entry and Track-B TP1

variants.name: clear_to_tp2
variants.rule: no active HTF SR zone blocks price between Entry and Track-B TP2

variants.name: backing_and_clear_tp1
variants.rule: backing zone present AND no blocking SR before TP1

variants.name: tp2_in_sr_zone
variants.rule: Track-B TP2 lies inside an already-active HTF SR zone

variants.name: backing_and_tp2_in_zone
variants.rule: backing zone present AND Track-B TP2 lies inside active HTF SR zone
